description:
Read a complete workspace email by ID.

        Returns ``body_text``, ``body_html`` and other email fields.
        Inbound records include reply headers and spam, virus, SPF, DKIM and DMARC verdicts.
        Attachments include IDs and file metadata.
        An unknown or inaccessible email returns an error.

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: get_email

EmailAttachmentResponse.description:
One inbound MIME attachment as exposed to API consumers.

``url`` is the stable Hail API endpoint that 302-redirects to a
presigned S3 URL on access — see GET /emails/{id}/attachments/{aid}.

content_id.description: MIME Content-ID, present when this attachment is referenced inline (cid:) from the HTML body. Null otherwise.
content_id.title: Content Id

size_bytes.description: Size of the attachment in bytes.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

url.description: API endpoint that 302-redirects to a presigned download URL for this attachment.
url.title: Url

EmailAttachmentResponse.title: EmailAttachmentResponse

agent_id.description: The agent this email belongs to: the address's agent on inbound rows, the writer on outbound rows.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

agent_reply_state.description: Inbound rows routed to an agent: 'pending', 'processing', 'done', 'skipped', or 'failed'. A skipped row names why in metadata.agent_skip_reason.
agent_reply_state.title: Agent Reply State

attachments.description: Inbound MIME attachments on this email. Empty on outbound rows.
attachments.title: Attachments

bcc_addresses.description: BCC recipient email addresses, if any.
bcc_addresses.title: Bcc Addresses

cc_addresses.description: CC recipient email addresses, if any.
cc_addresses.title: Cc Addresses

direction.description: 'outbound' for emails Hail sent, 'inbound' for emails received.
direction.title: Direction

dkim_verdict.description: Provider DKIM-authentication verdict (e.g. 'PASS'/'FAIL'). Inbound emails only; null on outbound rows.
dkim_verdict.title: Dkim Verdict

dmarc_verdict.description: Provider DMARC-authentication verdict (e.g. 'PASS'/'FAIL'). Inbound emails only; null on outbound rows.
dmarc_verdict.title: Dmarc Verdict

email_domain_id.description: The sending domain used, if from_address belongs to one of the org's configured domains.
email_domain_id.title: Email Domain Id

end_reason.description: Reason delivery failed or bounced, if applicable. Null on success or while pending.
end_reason.title: End Reason

failed_at.description: When the send failed, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null unless it failed.
failed_at.title: Failed At

from_name.description: Display name used on the From: header, when the sender supplied one. Always null on inbound rows.
from_name.title: From Name

in_reply_to.description: RFC 5322 In-Reply-To header. Set on inbound emails and agent replies; null on other outbound rows.
in_reply_to.title: In Reply To

last_event_at.description: When the most recent delivery event for this email occurred, ISO 8601 timestamp.
last_event_at.title: Last Event At

message_id.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID header. Inbound emails only; null on outbound rows.
message_id.title: Message Id

metadata.description: Free-form JSON object attached to the email, as sent on create. Not interpreted by Hail.
metadata.title: Metadata

organization_id.description: Organization that sent or received this email.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

provider_message_id.description: The email provider's identifier for this message, if assigned.
provider_message_id.title: Provider Message Id

provider_received_at.description: When the provider received this email, ISO 8601 timestamp. Inbound emails only.
provider_received_at.title: Provider Received At

raw_url.description: API endpoint that redirects to the original MIME blob. Inbound emails only; null on outbound rows.
raw_url.title: Raw Url

references_ids.description: RFC 5322 References header, split into ids. Set on inbound emails and agent replies; null on other outbound rows.
references_ids.title: References Ids

requested_at.description: When the send was requested, ISO 8601 timestamp.
requested_at.title: Requested At

sent_at.description: When the message was handed to the provider, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null until sent.
sent_at.title: Sent At

spam_verdict.description: Provider spam-scan verdict (e.g. 'PASS'/'FAIL'). Inbound emails only; null on outbound rows.
spam_verdict.title: Spam Verdict

spf_verdict.description: Provider SPF-authentication verdict (e.g. 'PASS'/'FAIL'). Inbound emails only; null on outbound rows.
spf_verdict.title: Spf Verdict

virus_verdict.description: Provider virus-scan verdict (e.g. 'PASS'/'FAIL'). Inbound emails only; null on outbound rows.
virus_verdict.title: Virus Verdict

title: Get an email
